markdownRemark.html:
After a decade of trying every editor, terminal, and tool combination imaginable, I've landed somewhere quiet and efficient.

Editor: Neovim with a minimal config. I tried VS Code for years — it's great, but I kept reaching for the keyboard shortcuts that don't exist.

Terminal: Ghostty. Fast, simple, stays out of the way.

Shell: Zsh with a hand-rolled config. No frameworks — I want to know exactly what's running.

Notes: Plain Markdown files in a Git repo. I've tried Notion, Obsidian, Roam. I always come back to files.

Music while working: Mostly ambient or jazz. Anything with lyrics pulls me out of flow.

The best setup is the one you stop thinking about.

frontmatter.title: The dev setup I've settled on after 10 years
